headline: 'Across-the-board rise': Seoul gifts highest since 2021... outlying areas up 90% as well as Gangnam
summary: Gifts of condominium units in Seoul this year surpassed last year's total within seven months, rising in Gangnam and in mid-tier and outlying districts alike.
why: Property transfers and gifts reflect housing market activity and tax planning, which influences Seoul home prices and policy debates.
